Changelog

Built by one person. Updates ship when they ship.

1.1.1 March 6, 2026 Latest

New

  • Folder deletion — select a folder and choose to delete its contents, remove the folder and keep songs, or delete everything

Bug Fixes

  • Fixed chord dragging snapping to the bottom of the document, making it nearly impossible to reposition chords
  • Folders can now actually be deleted — the option was previously missing from the UI
1.1 March 1, 2026

New

  • Song Notes — a rich text notepad attached to each song for writing ideas, session notes, or anything you need alongside your lyrics
  • Conversion nudges that gently surface Pro and Lifetime options as you approach free-tier limits

Improvements

  • Paywall, trial, and subscription modals are now fullscreen with proper safe-area handling — no more awkward floating cards on small screens
  • PRO badges display correctly on all sidebar buttons
  • Cleaner, faster rendering across the app — reduced unnecessary re-renders and deduplicated shared code
1.0.3 February 23, 2026

Performance

  • Keyboard now appears instantly when tapping the editor — eliminated cold-start delay on first use
  • Editor feels significantly snappier with reduced input lag when typing and formatting
  • Instrument sounds load during the splash screen so playback is ready sooner
  • Smoother toolbar and footer animations that match iOS keyboard timing

Bug Fixes

  • Fixed bullet and numbered lists not rendering properly in the editor
1.0.2 January 26, 2026
  • Fixed cloud storage sign-in on iOS devices
  • Resolved drum pattern audio playback issues
  • Fixed annoying Apple ID password prompts
  • Improved app stability
1.0.1 January 19, 2026

New

  • Cloud Sync: connect Google Drive or Dropbox to back up your songs
  • Added subscription plan toggle (monthly / yearly)

Bug Fixes

  • Fixed dropdown menus not responding on iOS
  • Improved accessibility and button contrast
  • General stability improvements
1.0.0 January 15, 2026

The beginning. After about eight months of building, SongScribe shipped to the App Store.

  • Chord-aware lyric editor with natural chord placement
  • Fullscreen performance mode with auto-scroll
  • Multi-take audio recorder with waveform editing
  • Chord library for guitar, bass, ukulele, and piano
  • Setlist builder for gigs and rehearsals
  • Chromatic tuner and metronome with tap tempo
  • Import from ChordPro, text, tabs, and PDFs
  • Export to PDF, ChordPro, and plain text
  • Works 100% offline. No account required.
